- COMPANY & PERIOD: Walmart Inc. for Fiscal Years 2018 and 2019
- PRIMARY METRIC: 
  - FY2018 Operating Income: $22,889 million (per the FY2019 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Income)
  - FY2019 Operating Income: $30,045 million (per the FY2019 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Income)
  
- SUPPORTING DATA:
  - FY2018 Total Revenue: $500,343 million (per the FY2019 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Income)
  - FY2019 Total Revenue: $514,405 million (per the FY2019 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Income)
  
  - FY2018 Operating Income Percentage Margin: (Operating Income / Total Revenue) * 100 = ($22,889 million / $500,343 million) * 100 = 4.6%
  - FY2019 Operating Income Percentage Margin: (Operating Income / Total Revenue) * 100 = ($24,202 million / $514,405 million) * 100 = 16.1%
  
  - Change in Operating Income Percentage Margin: 4.7% - 4.6% = 0.1%

- DATA SOURCES: 
  - Walmart Inc. FY2019 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Income, filed with the SEC on March 28, 2019.
